age: Details of the BM-MSC donors: 40y/m (StemCell, MSC-001F, lot#BM2893), 39y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#1F3422), 27y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#318006), 20y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#8F3520).
cell_line: Permission to use the human embryonic stem cell line (hESC) ES04 (WiCell institute) was obtained from the Cornell/Rockefeller/Sloan Kettering tri-institutional ESC research oversight committee.
cell_type: Here we performed an in depth characterization of human ESC-MSC, comparing them to human bone marrow-derived MSC (BM-MSC) as well as human embryonic stem cells (hESC) by transcriptomics (RNA-seq) and quantitative proteomics (nanoLC-MS/MS using SILAC).
developmental_stage: Embryonic stem cell-derived MSC (ESC-MSC) may provide an alternative, but how similar they are to ex vivo MSC is unknown.
material_type: ESC-MSC used for transcriptomic and proteomic profiling were generated in three independent experiments.
sample_source: All cells were cultured at 37 °C in an atmosphere supplemented to 5% CO2.
sex: Since the origin ESC line is male, only male BM-MSC donors were selected.
species: MS data was analyzed by MaxQuant suite of algorithms version 1.4.1.2 using a Homo Sapiens database downloaded from UniprotKB on the 27th of November 2013 and comprising 88,473 protein isoforms entries.
tissue: comparing them to human bone marrow-derived MSC (BM-MSC) as well as human embryonic stem cells (hESC)
